title: The Current of the Sepik Basin
author: Kestrel Lockridge
blurb: Paloma Thackeray, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
